pucRule.citation: N.Y. Public Service Law §§ 30–53 — Home Energy Fair Practices Act (HEFPA)
pucRule.title: New York residential customer protections
pucRule.summary: Establishes residential protections covering deferred payment agreements, special protections for elderly, blind or disabled customers, and cold-weather procedures.

deferredPaymentArrangement.note: HEFPA requires utilities to offer a deferred payment agreement fitted to the customer's financial circumstances.

moratoria.label: Cold weather period protections
moratoria.appliesTo: Residential customers; heightened procedures before termination

moratoria.label: Special protections household
moratoria.appliesTo: Households meeting a special-protections category — termination requires additional process year-round

authorityRule.title: Meridian Energy voice-agent delegated authority — New York
authorityRule.text: Voice agents may agree residual payment arrangements at or above $155 per month in New York. Amounts below the floor require credit-officer approval at authority level L2 or above.
